opencodePanel.configuration.title: OpenCode Panel
opencodePanel.config.serverUrl.markdownD: Full URL of an already-running opencode server (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:4096`). When empty, the extension derives the endpoint from `opencodePanel.hostname` and `opencodePanel.port` and may spawn its own managed server.
opencodePanel.config.port.markdownDescri: Port for the opencode server the extension connects to (and spawns, when `opencodePanel.autoStartServer` is enabled). Ignored when `opencodePanel.serverUrl` is set.
opencodePanel.config.hostname.markdownDe: Hostname for the opencode server the extension connects to (and spawns). Keep `127.0.0.1` unless you know the server binds elsewhere. Ignored when `opencodePanel.serverUrl` is set.
opencodePanel.config.binaryPath.markdown: Path (or name on `PATH`) of the `opencode` binary used to spawn a managed server.
opencodePanel.config.serverArgs.markdown: Extra arguments appended to `opencode serve --port <port> --hostname <hostname>` when the extension spawns a managed server.
opencodePanel.config.autoStartServer.mar: When enabled, the extension spawns a managed `opencode serve` process if no healthy server is found on the configured endpoint. Foreign (user-started) servers are only ever attached to, never killed.
opencodePanel.config.minimumServerVersio: Minimum accepted opencode server version. Servers below this version still run, but the extension shows a warning and hides features the server does not expose. `0.0.0` disables the floor (warn-only).
opencodePanel.config.debugLogs.markdownD: Write verbose debug output (with secret redaction) to the "OpenCode Panel" output channel.
opencodePanel.config.chatFontFamily.mark: Font family for chat message rendering in the panel. Empty inherits the VS Code editor font.
opencodePanel.config.chatFontSize.markdo: Font size (px) for chat message rendering in the panel. `0` inherits the VS Code default.
